item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is packed, and that's exactly when meals get skipped or rushed. Decide now what you'll eat at midday, before the schedule decides for you. Aim for protein and something green, and sit down to eat it. Stress makes grabbing whatever's closest the default. Plan removes the choice. Your evening wind-down goes better on a steady stomach, too.
Action: pick your midday meal right now.
